query:
SELECT
                s.user_id,
                u.display_name,
                s.cursor_line,
                s.cursor_column
            FROM active_sessions s
            INNER JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id
            WHERE s.note_id = $1
                AND s.last_seen_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes'
            ORDER BY s.last_seen_at DESC
